top_findings: ✅ All original critical issues resolved (robots.txt, sitemap, canonical, schema, stub pages)
17 of 17 pages complete with substantive content (was 9/15)
Comprehensive structured data suite (7 schema types) deployed site-wide
Author bylines + first-hand experience signals throughout

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt with AI crawler directives (GPTBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot)
Self-referencing canonical on all pages via BaseLayout
Meta robots with dynamic index/noindex support

remaining.title: No security headers
remaining.description: No HSTS, CSP, or X-Frame-Options configured. Needs deployment-level configuration (Vercel/Cloudflare).
remaining.recommendation: Add public/_headers for Vercel or equivalent for target deployment platform.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: All 17 pages have complete, substantive content (0 stubs, was 6/15)
First-hand experience: "we visited in April 2026" throughout
Author bylines on all content pages
External citations (UNESCO, official park sites, climate data)
Clear pricing/transport data with verification notes

remaining.title: Duplicate ticket price content
remaining.description: /guide and /tickets both contain full ticket price table. Near-duplicate blocks weaken canonical signal.
remaining.recommendation: Keep full table on /tickets; summarize and link from /guide.

remaining.title: Article author uses Organization type in schema
remaining.description: JSON-LD Article.author uses @type:Organization. E-E-A-T favors Person authors.
remaining.recommendation: Change to @type:Person across all article schemas.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title tags: keyword + context + year pattern throughout
Meta descriptions: present, unique, optimal length on all pages
H1: single per page, clean headings
OG tags complete: title, description, image, url, locale, site_name, type
Visual breadcrumbs with aria-label on inner pages
Footer navigation organized by user intent (Plan/Explore/Practical/About)

remaining.title: No reusable breadcrumb UI component
remaining.description: Visual breadcrumbs are per-page inline HTML, not a shared component.
remaining.recommendation: Extract breadcrumb into a reusable Astro component.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization + Person schema in BaseLayout (every page)

remaining.title: Article.author uses Organization not Person
remaining.description: All Article JSON-LD blocks use @type:Organization for author. For E-E-A-T, Person with credentials is preferred.
remaining.recommendation: Change author type to Person across all article schemas.

remaining.title: Generic Person schema name
remaining.description: Person schema uses 'Zhangjiajie Guide Team' — consider individual author names with credentials.
remaining.recommendation: Update when individual author page/credentials are ready.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: System font stack — no font downloads

remaining.title: No responsive images (srcset)
remaining.description: Mobile users download 1920px hero image. No srcset with multiple resolutions.
remaining.recommendation: Add srcset with 640w/1280w/1920w variants for hero and feature images.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt with structured page listing and descriptions
AI crawler directives in robots.txt (GPTBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot)
Clear, quotable statements with specific statistics
Author bylines with first-hand experience (counters AI-content flag)

remaining.title: No original research or unique data
remaining.description: Most facts are available on competing sites. Unique data would improve AI citability.
remaining.recommendation: Publish original comparisons, measurements, or survey data as a differentiator.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Descriptive, keyword-relevant alt text on all images
Appropriate image sizing for display contexts

remaining.title: No responsive srcset
remaining.description: All devices receive full-resolution images regardless of viewport width.

phases.name: Phase 1: Pre-Launch Polish
items: Add security headers (public/_headers for deployment platform)
Fix duplicate ticket price table (summarize on /guide)
Change Article.author schema from Organization to Person
Verify OG image is separate 1200×630 file

phases.name: Phase 2: Quality Enhancements
items: Add srcset for responsive hero + feature images
Add preconnect for external domains if applicable

phases.name: Phase 3: Growth
items: Create blog section for long-tail keyword coverage
Publish original data/research for AI differentiation
Build backlinks from travel blogs and directories
Add review/testimonial section for social proof
